This OpenFlowsheet version can't represent the case, so I built nothing and committed no revision. I made this call from the model list alone. I didn't try to commit or validate any draft.

The case needs nanofiltration, bipolar electrodialysis, a CO2 absorber, a crystallizer and a solid-liquid separator. It also needs a custom property package that carries a solid phase. The available models are generic: mixers, splitters, a component separator, a conversion reactor, heaters, flashes, a pump, a valve, and feed and product blocks.

- **BipolarElectrodialysis (BPED):** No electrochemical unit exists. The case reports a BPED voltage and an alkalinity fraction, and no available model has those quantities.
- **Absorber:** No gas-liquid absorber exists. A flash or a conversion reactor would not be a CO2 absorber, and the case says not to substitute units.
- **Crystallizer:** No crystallizer or solubility-based precipitation unit exists. The Liq/Vap/Sol phase set for Li2CO3 can't be handled either.
- **Nanofiltration (NF):** No membrane unit exists. A component separator with fixed splits would only mimic one, so I left it out.
- **SolidLiquidSeparator:** No unit exists for this. Only a fixed-split component separator comes close, which would be a substitute.
- **Property package:** The case names `native_pyomo_conservation_model`, a custom package with five tracked species and a solid phase. The models I could see have no such property route. Nothing in them shows that the species Li+, Mg2+, OH-, CO2 and Li2CO3 are available.
